target_customer: Companies with hybrid teams that need desk, room and car park booking and office usage data
problem: Hybrid teams cannot coordinate who is in the office and which desks are used. Officely started in 2017 as HotelFlex for flexible hotel check-in times and pivoted to office desk booking in 2020 to 2021.
business_model: B2B SaaS priced per bookable space per month

founders.name: Max Shepherd-Cross
founders.background_notes: Startup Daily, Dec 2021 says he co-founded HotelFlex. The YC page says he founded Tempa.

founders.name: Rich Turnbull
founders.background_notes: Listed as Founder/CTO on the YC page and named as HotelFlex founder by TechCrunch, Jul 2017.

founders.name: Pete Turnbull
founders.background_notes: Named with the other two as HotelFlex founder in TechCrunch, Jul 2017. Not named in later Officely coverage.

competitors.name: Online travel agencies such as Expedia
competitors.what: Third-party hotel booking platforms with higher customer acquisition costs than direct booking, per the founders

technical_complexity.rationale: Hotel flexible check-in needed property management system integrations and occupancy forecasting. The later desk booking product is Slack and Teams integration plus booking logic, which is standard software.

defensibility.rationale: Booking rules and integrations create some switching cost, but desk booking tools are easy to copy and the company markets on price.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No named incumbent reaction found in sources; the 2021 coverage names no competitors.

market_need_then: HotelFlex in 2017 aimed to sell flexible check-in and check-out times to hotels, taking 15 percent of extra revenue. COVID cut off hotel customers in 2020, and hybrid work then created demand for desk booking.

branding.domain_note: Uses getofficely.com rather than officely.com, suggesting the exact .com was not obtained. No source states this.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and plain, contrasts itself with competitors on price

branding.brand_signature: One flat price per bookable space with every feature included

rebrands.why: Pivot from hotel booking to office desk booking, per TechCrunch Dec 2021; the explicit name change is inferred from the pivot story and not stated

brand_strength.rationale: Mostly review-site and own-site marketing. No press or community evidence about the brand itself.

pivots.from: HotelFlex: flexible hotel check-in and check-out times sold to hotels
pivots.to: Officely: desk and room booking for hybrid offices
pivots.why: COVID lockdowns removed nearly all hotel customers

outcome_analysis: The YC S17 company was HotelFlex, which lost its hotel customers in 2020 and pivoted to desk booking. Officely launched in April 2021, claimed over 1,500 companies by December 2021 when it raised a $2M seed, and now claims 500 plus paying companies on its own site. It is a small, still-active SaaS company riding hybrid work, with no later round found.
notes: YC page lists founded 2021 and says Max Shepherd-Cross founded Tempa; Startup Daily and TechCrunch say he co-founded HotelFlex, which matches the S17 batch. CB Insights shows $3.7M over 2 rounds, other aggregators $2M; the extra amount is unverified. Customer counts differ between the 2021 article (1,500) and the company site (500 plus). Linking HotelFlex to Officely rests on the Startup Daily piece and the YC batch match.
